label: TP
reason: User input flows through multiple transformations (StringBuilder, replace, substring, Base64 encode/decode, split) but ultimately reaches printf() sink with format string capability intact. The transformations are obfuscation attempts that do not neutralize format specifiers (%s, %n, etc.) which can survive the entire pipeline and trigger format string XSS.

evidence.note: tainted param flows through transformations to printf sink with format string vulnerability
